messages.subject: Project Onyx - R&D enquiry and tax warranties
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

On the FY24 R&D claim (£341k) under HMRC enquiry: our view remains that the claim is well supported and we expect resolution without material adjustment. For the disclosure letter, I'd disclose the enquiry specifically against the tax warranty and note our assessment. Happy to provide a short note for the bundle.

Duncan Reeves | Marlow Tax & Advisory Ltd
